items.q: That's the time that Scott-- what's his name-- (died in a car crash)

ctx.x: Sometimes he did and sometimes he didn't. I would say it was fifty-fifty. That's the time that Scott-- what's his name-- (died in a car crash)
And another fellow; all these things happened at the same time (inaudible). Let's say it was fifty-fifty where he had the track--
